name: Tab (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Tab (a quartered red and blue shield with birds and a ploughshare, with a mural crown and yellow lion supporters) above the name TAB in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tab arms with mural crown and lion supporters
